segments.text:
V. 63.
It is the Spirit— The ſpiritual Meaning of theſe Words, by which GOD giveth Life. The fleſh—The bare, carnal, literal Meaning, profiteth nothing. The words which I have ſpoken, they are ſpirit—Are to be taken in a ſpiritual Senſe; and, when they are ſo underſtood, they are life—That is, a Means of ſpiritual Life to the Hearers.
